mvs.sql:
SELECT uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    stc.leto_izgradnje,
    n.polni_naslovi AS polni_naslov,
    stc.stevilo_etaz,
    stc.stavba_id,
    ds.del_stavbe_id,
    stc.ko_id,
    stc.st_stavbe,
    ds.st_dela_stavbe,
    concat(stc.ko_id, '-', stc.st_stavbe, '-', ds.st_dela_stavbe) AS ko_stst_stdst,
    sifdr.naziv AS dej_raba_dst,
    ds.povrsina AS neto_povrsina,
    ds.vrsta_dejanske_rabe_del_st_id,
    ds.uporabna_povrsina,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (0)::numeric) THEN 'NULL'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (1)::numeric) THEN 'DA'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (2)::numeric) THEN 'DA'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (3)::numeric) THEN 'NE'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (4)::numeric) THEN 'DA'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = (5)::numeric) THEN 'NULL'::text
            WHEN ((ds.status)::numeric = ('-1'::integer)::numeric) THEN 'NULL'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS kat_vpis,
        CASE
            WHEN (ds.etazna_lastnina = 0) THEN 'NULL'::text
            WHEN (ds.etazna_lastnina = 1) THEN 'DA'::text
            WHEN (ds.etazna_lastnina = 2) THEN 'NE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS etazna_lastnina,
        CASE
            WHEN (ds.skupni_del_etazna_lastnina = 0) THEN 'NULL'::text
            WHEN (ds.skupni_del_etazna_lastnina = 1) THEN 'DA'::text
            WHEN (ds.skupni_del_etazna_lastnina = 2) THEN 'NE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS skupni_del_etazna_lasnina,
        CASE
            WHEN (stzps.geom IS NOT NULL) THEN 'ZPS geom'::text
            ELSE 'Obrisi geom'::text
        END AS vrsta_geom,
    (st_setsrid(COALESCE(stzps.geom, st_multi(sto.geom)), 3794))::geometry(MultiPolygon,3794) AS geom,
    ev_vrednost.vrednost,
    ev_vrednost.posplosena_vrednost
   FROM ((((((( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.del_stavbe_id) d.del_stavbe_id,
            d.stavba_id,
            d.st_dela_stavbe,
            d.vrsta_dejanske_rabe_del_st_id,
            d.povrsina,
            d.uporabna_povrsina,
            d.status,
            d.etazna_lastnina,
            d.skupni_del_etazna_lastnina
           FROM kn_nep_deli_stavb_h d
          WHERE (d.datum_do > '2040-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone)
          ORDER BY d.del_stavbe_id, d.datum_sys DESC) ds
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.stavba_id) s.stavba_id,
            s.leto_izgradnje,
            s.ko_id,
            s.stevilo_etaz,
            s.st_stavbe
           FROM kn_nep_stavbe_centroidi_h s
          WHERE (s.datum_do > '2040-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone)
          ORDER BY s.stavba_id, s.datum_sys DESC) stc ON ((stc.stavba_id = ds.stavba_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (z.stavba_id) z.stavba_id,
            z.geom
           FROM kn_nep_stavbe_zps_h z
          WHERE (z.datum_do > '2040-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone)
          ORDER BY z.stavba_id, z.datum_sys DESC) stzps ON ((stc.stavba_id = stzps.stavba_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.stavba_id) o.stavba_id,
            o.geom
           FROM kn_nep_stavbe_obrisi_h o
          WHERE (o.datum_do > '2040-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone)
          ORDER BY o.stavba_id, o.datum_sys DESC) sto ON ((stc.stavba_id = sto.stavba_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT string_agg(n_1.polni_naslov, '; '::text) AS polni_naslovi,
            n_1.stavba_id
           FROM kn_nep_naslovi_view n_1
          GROUP BY n_1.stavba_id) n ON ((stc.stavba_id = n.stavba_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sif.sifra,
            sif.naziv
           FROM pp_sif_dej_raba_dst_model sif) sifdr ON (((ds.vrsta_dejanske_rabe_del_st_id)::numeric = (sifdr.sifra)::numeric)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ev_del_stavbe_enota_h_2025_danes.dst_sid,
            ev_del_stavbe_enota_h_2025_danes.vrednost,
            ev_del_stavbe_enota_h_2025_danes.posplosena_vrednost
           FROM ev_del_stavbe_enota_h_2025_danes
          WHERE (ev_del_stavbe_enota_h_2025_danes.valid_to IS NULL)) ev_vrednost ON ((ds.del_stavbe_id = ev_vrednost.dst_sid)));

mvs.sql:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT t.id AS id_trans,
            t.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
            t.dat_pri,
            v.spremenljivke,
            v.faktorji,
            v.pasivni_modeli
           FROM (md_trans t
             JOIN md_trans_vmesni_izr v ON ((v.id_rel_md_trans = t.id)))
        ), sp AS (
         SELECT b.id_trans,
            b.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
            'spremenljivke'::text AS skupina,
            (k.ord)::integer AS ord,
            k.key AS kljuc,
            NULLIF(((COALESCE(b.spremenljivke, '{}'::text))::text[])[k.ord], 'null'::text) AS vrednost
           FROM ((base b
             JOIN md_verzije_modeli vm ON ((vm.id = b.id_rel_verzije_modeli)))
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest((COALESCE(vm.spremenljivke, '{}'::text))::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(key, ord))
        ), fa AS (
         SELECT b.id_trans,
            b.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
            'faktorji'::text AS skupina,
            (k.ord)::integer AS ord,
            k.key AS kljuc,
            NULLIF(((COALESCE(b.faktorji, '{}'::text))::text[])[k.ord], 'null'::text) AS vrednost
           FROM ((base b
             JOIN md_verzije_modeli vm ON ((vm.id = b.id_rel_verzije_modeli)))
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest((COALESCE(vm.faktorji, '{}'::text))::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(key, ord))
        ), pm AS (
         SELECT b.id_trans,
            b.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
            'pasivni_modeli'::text AS skupina,
            (k.ord)::integer AS ord,
            k.key AS kljuc,
            NULLIF(((COALESCE(b.pasivni_modeli, '{}'::text))::text[])[k.ord], 'null'::text) AS vrednost
           FROM ((base b
             JOIN md_verzije_modeli vm ON ((vm.id = b.id_rel_verzije_modeli)))
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest((COALESCE(vm.pasivni_modeli, '{}'::text))::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(key, ord))
        )
 SELECT sp.id_trans,
    sp.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
    sp.skupina,
    sp.ord,
    sp.kljuc,
    sp.vrednost
   FROM sp
UNION ALL
 SELECT fa.id_trans,
    fa.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
    fa.skupina,
    fa.ord,
    fa.kljuc,
    fa.vrednost
   FROM fa
UNION ALL
 SELECT pm.id_trans,
    pm.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
    pm.skupina,
    pm.ord,
    pm.kljuc,
    pm.vrednost
   FROM pm;

mvs.sql:
SELECT uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    t1.id_rel_fo,
    round(COALESCE(fgv.povrsina, t1.atr_povr), 1) AS atr_povr,
        CASE
            WHEN (fgv.geom IS NOT NULL) THEN round((st_area(fgv.geom))::numeric, 1)
            ELSE round((st_area(t1.geom))::numeric, 1)
        END AS geom_povr,
    (st_setsrid(st_multi(COALESCE(fgv.geom, t1.geom)), 3794))::geometry(MultiPolygon,3794) AS geom,
        CASE
            WHEN (fgv.id IS NOT NULL) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS gv_geom_povr
   FROM (((( SELECT sub.id_rel_fo,
            round(sum(sub.povrsina), 1) AS atr_povr,
            st_collectionextract(st_collect(sub.geom), 3) AS geom
           FROM ( SELECT p.id_rel_fo,
                    p.povrsina,
                    p.geom
                   FROM pev_parcele p
                  WHERE (p.fo_geom_upost = true)
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT s.id_rel_fo,
                    d.povrsina,
                    s.geom
                   FROM (pev_deli_stavb d
                     JOIN pev_stavbe s ON ((d.id_rel_sta = s.id)))
                  WHERE (s.fo_geom_upost = true)) sub
          GROUP BY sub.id_rel_fo) t1
     LEFT JOIN pev_fo fo1 ON ((t1.id_rel_fo = fo1.id)))
     LEFT JOIN pev_posebne_enote pev1 ON ((fo1.id_rel_pe = pev1.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( WITH filtered_rows AS (
                 SELECT pev_fo_gv_arhiv.id,
                    pev_fo_gv_arhiv.id_rel_pe,
                    pev_fo_gv_arhiv.povrsina,
                    pev_fo_gv_arhiv.geom
                   FROM pev_fo_gv_arhiv
                  WHERE (pev_fo_gv_arhiv.valid_to = '3000-01-01'::date)
                )
         SELECT filtered_rows.id,
            filtered_rows.id_rel_pe,
            filtered_rows.povrsina,
            filtered_rows.geom
           FROM filtered_rows
          WHERE (filtered_rows.id_rel_pe IN ( SELECT filtered_rows_1.id_rel_pe
                   FROM filtered_rows filtered_rows_1
                  GROUP BY filtered_rows_1.id_rel_pe
                 HAVING (count(filtered_rows_1.id_rel_pe) = 1)))) fgv ON ((pev1.id = fgv.id_rel_pe)));

            WHEN ((ppv_strosek.strosek IS NOT NULL) AND (sif_vp_strosek.naziv IS NOT NULL)) THEN concat(ppv_strosek.strosek, ' | ', sif_vp_strosek.naziv)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS strosek,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ppv_st_privezov.st_privezov IS NOT NULL) AND (sif_vp_st_privezov.naziv IS NOT NULL)) THEN concat(ppv_st_privezov.st_privezov, ' | ', sif_vp_st_privezov.naziv)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS st_privezov,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ppv_st_nam_na_suhem.st_nam_na_suhem IS NOT NULL) AND (sif_vp_st_nam_na_suhem.naziv IS NOT NULL)) THEN concat(ppv_st_nam_na_suhem.st_nam_na_suhem, ' | ', sif_vp_st_nam_na_suhem.naziv)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS st_nam_na_suhem,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ppv_st_nam_v_hangarju.st_nam_v_hangarju IS NOT NULL) AND (sif_vp_st_nam_v_hangarju.naziv IS NOT NULL)) THEN concat(ppv_st_nam_v_hangarju.st_nam_v_hangarju, ' | ', sif_vp_st_nam_v_hangarju.naziv)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS st_nam_v_hangarju,
        CASE
            WHEN ((sif_vrsta_pristanisca.naziv IS NOT NULL) AND (sif_vp_vrsta_pristanisca.naziv IS NOT NULL)) THEN concat(sif_vrsta_pristanisca.naziv, ' | ', sif_vp_vrsta_pristanisca.naziv)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS vrsta_pristanisca,
    pe_upr.id_rel_pe
   FROM ((((((((((((((( SELECT calc_pe_upr_id(t5.id, t3.id) AS id,
            t5.id AS id_rel_pe,
            t5.model,
            t3.id_upr
           FROM ((((pev_pe_upr_kon t1
             LEFT JOIN pev_kontakti t2 ON ((t1.id_rel_kontakt = t2.id)))
             LEFT JOIN pev_upravljavci t3 ON ((t2.id_rel_upr = t3.id)))
             LEFT JOIN prs_h t4 ON ((t3.id_rel_prs = t4.id)))
             LEFT JOIN pev_posebne_enote t5 ON ((t1.id_rel_pe = t5.id)))
          GROUP BY t5.id, t3.id, t4.ime_za_pev) pe_upr
     JOIN pev_pos pos ON (((pe_upr.id = pos.id_rel_pe_upr) AND ((pos.leto)::numeric >= (EXTRACT(year FROM now()) - (5)::numeric)))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_prihodek ON (((pos.id_prihodek = sif_vp_prihodek.sifra) AND (sif_vp_prihodek.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_prihodek ON (((ppv_prihodek.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_prihodek = ppv_prihodek.id_vira))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_strosek ON (((pos.id_strosek = sif_vp_strosek.sifra) AND (sif_vp_strosek.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_strosek ON (((ppv_strosek.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_strosek = ppv_strosek.id_vira))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_st_privezov ON (((pos.id_st_privezov = sif_vp_st_privezov.sifra) AND (sif_vp_st_privezov.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_st_privezov ON (((ppv_st_privezov.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_st_privezov = ppv_st_privezov.id_vira))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_st_nam_na_suhem ON (((pos.id_st_nam_na_suhem = sif_vp_st_nam_na_suhem.sifra) AND (sif_vp_st_nam_na_suhem.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_st_nam_na_suhem ON (((ppv_st_nam_na_suhem.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_st_nam_na_suhem = ppv_st_nam_na_suhem.id_vira))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_st_nam_v_hangarju ON (((pos.id_st_nam_v_hangarju = sif_vp_st_nam_v_hangarju.sifra) AND (sif_vp_st_nam_v_hangarju.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_st_nam_v_hangarju ON (((ppv_st_nam_v_hangarju.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_st_nam_v_hangarju = ppv_st_nam_v_hangarju.id_vira))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_sifrant sif_vp_vrsta_pristanisca ON (((pos.id_vrsta_pristanisca = sif_vp_vrsta_pristanisca.sifra) AND (sif_vp_vrsta_pristanisca.sifrant = 'vir_podatka'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN pev_pos_vnos ppv_vrsta_pristanisca ON (((ppv_vrsta_pristanisca.id_rel_pos = pos.id) AND (pos.id_vrsta_pristanisca = ppv_vrsta_pristanisca.id_vira))))

  WHERE (pe_upr.model = 'PNP'::text);

mvs.sql:
SELECT uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    b.del_stavbe_id,
    b.stavba_id,
    b.sif_ko,
    b.st_stavbe,
    b.st_dela_stavbe,
    b.ko_stst_stdst,
    b.katas_vpis,
    b.hisna_stevilka_id,
    b.st_stanovanja,
    b.dej_raba_dst,
    b.tip_stavbe,
    b.upor_povr,
    b.neto_povr,
    b.leto_izg,
    round(((b.zps_stavbe * b.neto_povr) / NULLIF(sum(b.neto_povr) OVER (PARTITION BY b.stavba_id), (0)::numeric)), 2) AS zps_dst,
    b.leto_obn_strehe,
    b.leto_obn_fasade,
    b.leto_obn_oken,
    b.leto_obn_inst,
    b.vhodna_etaza_dst,
    b.pritlicna_etaza_stavbe,
    b.id_lega,
    b.nadstropje,
    b.st_stanovanj,
    b.st_etaz,
    b.id_konstrukcije,
    b.id_vodovod,
    b.id_elektrika,
    b.id_kanalizacija,
    b.id_plin,
    b.id_dvigalo,
    b.neto_prost,
    b.visina_etaze_rzd,
    b.atr_povr,
    b.wkt_centroida,
    b.vrsta_geom,
    b.geom,
    b.vrednost,
    b.posplosena_vrednost
   FROM ( SELECT d.del_stavbe_id,
            d.stavba_id,
            s.ko_id AS sif_ko,
            s.st_stavbe,
            d.st_dela_stavbe,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((s.ko_id IS NULL) OR (s.st_stavbe IS NULL) OR (d.st_dela_stavbe IS NULL)) THEN NULL::text
                    ELSE concat(s.ko_id, '-', s.st_stavbe, '-', d.st_dela_stavbe)
                END AS ko_stst_stdst,
            d.status AS katas_vpis,
            (d.hisna_stevilka_id)::bigint AS hisna_stevilka_id,
            stan.st_stanovanja,
            d.vrsta_dejanske_rabe_del_st_id AS dej_raba_dst,
            s.tip_stavbe_id AS tip_stavbe,
            COALESCE(pov.upor_povr_iz_prostorov, NULLIF(d.uporabna_povrsina, (0)::numeric)) AS upor_povr,
            COALESCE(pov.neto_povr_iz_prostorov, NULLIF(d.povrsina, (0)::numeric)) AS neto_povr,
            NULLIF(s.leto_izgradnje, 0) AS leto_izg,
            zps.zps_stavbe,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(s.leto_obnove_strehe, 0) < NULLIF(s.leto_izgradnje, 0)) THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE NULLIF(s.leto_obnove_strehe, 0)
                END AS leto_obn_strehe,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(s.leto_obnove_fasade, 0) < NULLIF(s.leto_izgradnje, 0)) THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE NULLIF(s.leto_obnove_fasade, 0)
                END AS leto_obn_fasade,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(d.leto_obnove_oken, 0) < NULLIF(s.leto_izgradnje, 0)) THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE NULLIF(d.leto_obnove_oken, 0)
                END AS leto_obn_oken,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(d.leto_obnove_instalacij, 0) < NULLIF(s.leto_izgradnje, 0)) THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE NULLIF(d.leto_obnove_instalacij, 0)
                END AS leto_obn_inst,
            vhodna.stevilka_etaze AS vhodna_etaza_dst,
            pritlicna.stevilka_etaze AS pritlicna_etaza_stavbe,
                CASE
                    WHEN (vhodna.stevilka_etaze < pritlicna.stevilka_etaze) THEN 1
                    WHEN (vhodna.stevilka_etaze = pritlicna.stevilka_etaze) THEN 2
                    WHEN (vhodna.stevilka_etaze > pritlicna.stevilka_etaze) THEN 3
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS id_lega,
            (vhodna.stevilka_etaze - pritlicna.stevilka_etaze) AS nadstropje,
            s.stevilo_stanovanj AS st_stanovanj,
            s.stevilo_etaz AS st_etaz,
            s.nosilna_konstrukcija_id AS id_konstrukcije,
                CASE s.vodovod
                    WHEN 1 THEN true
                    WHEN 2 THEN false
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS id_vodovod,
                CASE s.elektrika
                    WHEN 1 THEN true
                    WHEN 2 THEN false
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS id_elektrika,
                CASE s.kanalizacija
                    WHEN 1 THEN true
                    WHEN 2 THEN false
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS id_kanalizacija,
                CASE s.plin
                    WHEN 1 THEN true
                    WHEN 2 THEN false
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS id_plin,
                CASE d.dvigalo
                    WHEN 1 THEN true
                    WHEN 2 THEN false
                    ELSE NULL::boolean
                END AS id_dvigalo,
            d.prostornina_cistern_silosov AS neto_prost,
                CASE
                    WHEN (vhodna.visina_etaze < 3.5) THEN 1
                    WHEN (vhodna.visina_etaze < (6)::numeric) THEN 2
                    WHEN (vhodna.visina_etaze < (12)::numeric) THEN 3
                    WHEN (vhodna.visina_etaze < (20)::numeric) THEN 4
                    WHEN (vhodna.visina_etaze >= (20)::numeric) THEN 5
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS visina_etaze_rzd,
            atr.atr_povr,
            st_astext(s.geom) AS wkt_centroida,
                CASE
                    WHEN (stzps.geom IS NOT NULL) THEN 'ZPS geom'::text
                    ELSE 'Obrisi geom'::text
                END AS vrsta_geom,
            (st_setsrid(COALESCE(stzps.geom, st_multi(o.geom)), 3794))::geometry(MultiPolygon,3794) AS geom,
            ev_vrednost.vrednost,
            ev_vrednost.posplosena_vrednost
           FROM ((((((((((( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d_1.del_stavbe_id) d_1.del_stavbe_id,
                    d_1.stavba_id,
                    d_1.hisna_stevilka_id,
                    d_1.vrsta_dejanske_rabe_del_st_id,
                    d_1.dvigalo,
                    d_1.leto_obnove_instalacij,
                    d_1.leto_obnove_oken,
                    d_1.povrsina,
                    d_1.uporabna_povrsina,
                    d_1.prostornina_cistern_silosov,
                    d_1.status,
                    d_1.st_dela_stavbe,
                    d_1.stanovanje_id
                   FROM kn_nep_deli_stavb_h d_1
                  WHERE ((d_1.del_stavbe_id IS NOT NULL) AND (d_1.datum_od <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (d_1.datum_do > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
                  ORDER BY d_1.del_stavbe_id, d_1.datum_sys DESC NULLS LAST, d_1.datum_od DESC NULLS LAST, d_1.del_stavbe_h_id DESC NULLS LAST) d
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s_1.stavba_id) s_1.stavba_id,
                    s_1.ko_id,
                    s_1.st_stavbe,
                    s_1.tip_stavbe_id,
                    s_1.leto_izgradnje,
                    s_1.leto_obnove_fasade,
                    s_1.leto_obnove_strehe,
                    s_1.stevilo_stanovanj,
                    s_1.stevilo_etaz,
                    s_1.nosilna_konstrukcija_id,
                    s_1.vodovod,
                    s_1.elektrika,
                    s_1.kanalizacija,
                    s_1.plin,
                    s_1.geom
                   FROM kn_nep_stavbe_centroidi_h s_1
                  WHERE ((s_1.stavba_id IS NOT NULL) AND (s_1.datum_od <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (s_1.datum_do > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
                  ORDER BY s_1.stavba_id, s_1.datum_sys DESC NULLS LAST, s_1.datum_od DESC NULLS LAST, s_1.stavba_h_id DESC NULLS LAST) s ON ((s.stavba_id = d.stavba_id)))
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (stzps_1.stavba_id) stzps_1.stavba_id,
                    stzps_1.geom
                   FROM kn_nep_stavbe_zps_h stzps_1
                  WHERE ((stzps_1.stavba_id IS NOT NULL) AND (stzps_1.datum_od <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (stzps_1.datum_do > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
                  ORDER BY stzps_1.stavba_id, stzps_1.datum_sys DESC NULLS LAST, stzps_1.datum_od DESC NULLS LAST) stzps ON ((stzps.stavba_id = d.stavba_id)))
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (o_1.stavba_id) o_1.stavba_id,
                    o_1.geom
                   FROM kn_nep_stavbe_obrisi_h o_1
                  WHERE ((o_1.stavba_id IS NOT NULL) AND (o_1.datum_od <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (o_1.datum_do > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
                  ORDER BY o_1.stavba_id, o_1.datum_sys DESC NULLS LAST, o_1.datum_od DESC NULLS LAST, o_1.stavba_h_id DESC NULLS LAST) o ON ((o.stavba_id = d.stavba_id)))
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (stan_1.stanovanje_id) stan_1.stanovanje_id,
                    stan_1.st_stanovanja
                   FROM kn_nep_stanovanja_h stan_1

SELECT uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    src.id_rel_pr_datum,
    src.presecni_datum,
    src.model,
    src.tip_enote,
    src.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
    src.verzija,
    count(1) AS st_enot,
    count(1) FILTER (WHERE (src.id_rel_pr_datum IS NULL)) AS st_brez_presecnega_datuma,
    count(1) FILTER (WHERE (src.id_rel_vm_pd IS NULL)) AS st_brez_konfiguracije_modela,
    count(1) FILTER (WHERE ((src.id_rel_vm_pd IS NOT NULL) AND (src.vrednost_izr IS NULL))) AS st_brez_izracunane_vrednosti,
    count(1) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS st_izracunanih_vrednosti,
    count(1) FILTER (WHERE ((src.napaka_priprave IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(src.napaka_priprave) <> ''::text))) AS st_napak_priprave,
    round((((count(1) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NULL)))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(1), 0))::numeric) / 0.01), 2) AS delez_brez_vrednosti_pct,
    sum(src.vrednost_izr) AS vsota_vrednost_izr,
    sum(src.vrednost_zaokrozena) AS vsota_vrednost_zaokrozena,
    min(src.vrednost_izr) AS min_vrednost_izr,
    max(src.vrednost_izr) AS max_vrednost_izr,
    avg(src.vrednost_izr) AS avg_vrednost_izr,
    percentile_cont((0.05)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((src.vrednost_izr)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS p05_vrednost_izr,
    percentile_cont((0.25)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((src.vrednost_izr)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS p25_vrednost_izr,
    percentile_cont((0.50)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((src.vrednost_izr)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS mediana_vrednost_izr,
    percentile_cont((0.75)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((src.vrednost_izr)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS p75_vrednost_izr,
    percentile_cont((0.95)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((src.vrednost_izr)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (src.vrednost_izr IS NOT NULL)) AS p95_vrednost_izr,
    stddev_pop(src.vrednost_izr) AS stddev_vrednost_izr,
    now() AS refreshed_at
   FROM ( SELECT e.id_pripis_enote,
            e.id_rel_pr_datum,
            pd.datum AS presecni_datum,
            e.model,
            e.tip_enote,
            e.poslovni_kljuc,
            e.napaka_priprave,
            k.id_rel_vm_pd,
            k.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
            k.verzija,
            r.vrednost_izr,
            r.vrednost_zaokrozena,
            r.spremenljivke_vrednosti,
            r.faktorji_vrednosti
           FROM (((( SELECT d.id AS id_pripis_enote,
                    d.id_rel_pr_datum,
                    d.model,
                    'DEL_STAVBE'::text AS tip_enote,
                    (d.del_stavbe_id)::text AS poslovni_kljuc,
                    d.napaka AS napaka_priprave
                   FROM pripis_enote_deli_stavb d
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT p.id AS id_pripis_enote,
                    p.id_rel_pr_datum,
                    p.model,
                    'DEL_PARC'::text AS tip_enote,
                    p.del_parcele_id AS poslovni_kljuc,
                    NULL::text AS napaka_priprave
                   FROM pripis_enote_deli_parcel p) e
             LEFT JOIN pripis_presecni_datum pd ON ((pd.id = e.id_rel_pr_datum)))
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.id AS id_rel_vm_pd,
                    x.id_rel_pr_datum,
                    x.id_rel_verzije_modeli,
                    vm.model,
                    vm.verzija
                   FROM (pripis_vm_x_pd x
                     JOIN md_verzije_modeli vm ON ((vm.id = x.id_rel_verzije_modeli)))) k ON (((k.id_rel_pr_datum = e.id_rel_pr_datum) AND (k.model = e.model))))
             LEFT JOIN pripis_vmxpd_x_enote r ON (((r.id_rel_vm_pd = k.id_rel_vm_pd) AND (r.id_rel_prip_enota = e.id_pripis_enote))))) src
  GROUP BY src.id_rel_pr_datum, src.presecni_datum, src.model, src.tip_enote, src.id_rel_verzije_modeli, src.verzija;

    uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    '0101000020D20E00005A5965247BA81D4177D08EB62697FA40'::geometry(Point,3794) AS geom
   FROM (((((((((( SELECT ("left"(si_surs_atr_inflacija.mesec, 4))::integer AS leto,

                    WHEN (razdeljeni_podatki.cetrtletje = '1'::text) THEN (razdeljeni_podatki.mesec + 0)
                    WHEN (razdeljeni_podatki.cetrtletje = '2'::text) THEN (razdeljeni_podatki.mesec + 3)
                    WHEN (razdeljeni_podatki.cetrtletje = '3'::text) THEN (razdeljeni_podatki.mesec + 6)
                    WHEN (razdeljeni_podatki.cetrtletje = '4'::text) THEN (razdeljeni_podatki.mesec + 9)
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS mesec,
            razdeljeni_podatki.indeks_stroskov_dela_skupaj_skd_dejavnost_skupaj
           FROM ( SELECT "left"(si_gurs_atr_ind_strosk.cetrtletje, 4) AS leto,
                    "right"(si_gurs_atr_ind_strosk.cetrtletje, 1) AS cetrtletje,
                    si_gurs_atr_ind_strosk.indeks_stroskov_dela_skupaj_skd_dejavnost_skupaj,
                    generate_series(1, 3) AS mesec
                   FROM si_gurs_atr_ind_strosk
                  WHERE (si_gurs_atr_ind_strosk.vrsta_podatka = 'Originalni podatki'::text)) razdeljeni_podatki) stroski ON (((inflacija.leto = stroski.leto) AND (inflacija.mesec = stroski.mesec))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_furs_dav_raz.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_furs_dav_raz.vsota_dohodnina_eur
           FROM si_furs_dav_raz
          WHERE (si_furs_dav_raz.davcni_razred = 'skupaj'::text)) dohodnina ON ((inflacija.leto = dohodnina.leto)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ("left"(si_surs_atr_tem_obr_mera.mesec, 4))::integer AS leto,
            ("right"(si_surs_atr_tem_obr_mera.mesec, 2))::integer AS mesec,
            si_surs_atr_tem_obr_mera.mesecni_tom,
            si_surs_atr_tem_obr_mera.letni_tom
           FROM si_surs_atr_tem_obr_mera) obr_mera ON (((inflacija.leto = obr_mera.leto) AND (inflacija.mesec = obr_mera.mesec))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_surs_atr_gosp_rast.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_surs_atr_gosp_rast.indeks_realne_rasti_bruto_domacega_proizvoda_na_prebivalca_inde,
            si_surs_atr_gosp_rast.stopnja_dolgotrajne_brezposelnosti
           FROM si_surs_atr_gosp_rast) gosp_rast ON ((inflacija.leto = gosp_rast.leto)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_umar_kazal_trga_dela.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_umar_kazal_trga_dela.zaposlenost_po_nacionalnih_racunih_v_tisoc,
            si_umar_kazal_trga_dela.formalno_delovno_aktivni_v_tisoc,
            si_umar_kazal_trga_dela.registrirani_brezposelni_v_tisoc
           FROM si_umar_kazal_trga_dela) trg_dela ON ((inflacija.leto = trg_dela.leto)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_surs_atr_kazal_prod_del_kapital.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_surs_atr_kazal_prod_del_kapital.realna_produktivnost_dela_na_zaposlenega,
            si_surs_atr_kazal_prod_del_kapital.neto_osnovna_sredstva_na_zaposlenega
           FROM si_surs_atr_kazal_prod_del_kapital
          WHERE (si_surs_atr_kazal_prod_del_kapital.meritve = 'Letna sprememba rasti'::text)) kapital ON ((inflacija.leto = kapital.leto)))
  ORDER BY inflacija.leto, inflacija.mesec DESC;

    (NULLIF(NULLIF(studenti.stevilo_studentov_na_1000_prebivalcev, '...'::text), '-'::text))::integer AS studenti_stevilo_studentov_na1kpreb,
    (NULLIF(grad_dov.stevilo_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_na_1000_prebivalcev, '-'::text))::numeric AS grad_dov_st_izdanih_grad_dovoljenj_na1kpreb,
    (NULLIF(grad_dov.delez_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_za_stanovanjske_stavbe, '-'::text))::numeric AS grad_dov_delez_izd_grad_dovoljenj_stan_stavbe,
    (NULLIF(grad_dov.delez_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_za_nestanovanjske_stavbe, '-'::text))::numeric AS grad_dov_delez_izd_grad_dovoljenj_nestan_stavbe,
    uuid_generate_v4() AS id,
    obg.geom
   FROM ((((( SELECT ("left"(si_surs_atr_star_preb.polletje, 4))::integer AS leto,
            ("right"(si_surs_atr_star_preb.polletje, 1))::integer AS polletje,
            si_surs_atr_star_preb.obcine,
            si_surs_atr_star_preb.povprecna_starost_leta,
            si_surs_atr_star_preb.indeks_staranja,
            si_surs_atr_star_preb.koeficient_starostne_odvisnosti
           FROM si_surs_atr_star_preb
          WHERE ((si_surs_atr_star_preb.spol = 'Spol - SKUPAJ'::text) AND (si_surs_atr_star_preb.obcine <> 'SLOVENIJA'::text))) star_preb
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_surs_atr_narav_gib_preb.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_surs_atr_narav_gib_preb.obcine,
            si_surs_atr_narav_gib_preb.naravni_prirast_skupaj
           FROM si_surs_atr_narav_gib_preb) gib_preb ON (((star_preb.leto = gib_preb.leto) AND (star_preb.obcine = gib_preb.obcine))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ("left"(si_surs_atr_st_stud.studijsko_leto, 4))::integer AS leto,
            si_surs_atr_st_stud.obcine,
            si_surs_atr_st_stud.stevilo_studentov_na_1000_prebivalcev
           FROM si_surs_atr_st_stud) studenti ON (((star_preb.leto = studenti.leto) AND (star_preb.obcine = studenti.obcine))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT (si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov.leto)::integer AS leto,
            si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov.obcine,
            si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov.stevilo_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_na_1000_prebivalcev,
            si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov.delez_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_za_nestanovanjske_stavbe,
            si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov.delez_izdanih_gradbenih_dovoljenj_za_stanovanjske_stavbe
           FROM si_surs_atr_st_izd_grad_dov) grad_dov ON (((star_preb.leto = grad_dov.leto) AND (star_preb.obcine = grad_dov.obcine))))
     LEFT JOIN si_gurs_nrpe_ob obg ON ((replace(replace(replace(split_part(star_preb.obcine, '/'::text, 1), ' - '::text, '-'::text), 'Slov.'::text, 'Slovenskih'::text), 'Andraž v Slovenskih'::text, 'Andraž v Slov.'::text) = obg.naziv)))
  ORDER BY star_preb.leto, star_preb.polletje, star_preb.obcine;
